steps.title: Validate App Metadata and Package Configuration
steps.description: Verify package configuration and metadata parameters for Al Faris Kirana.

steps.title: Configure Application Build Environment and Gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Set up SDK level 34, Temurin 17 compatibility, and compile options in build.gradle.

steps.title: Define Local SQLite Database Schema and Helper Functions
steps.description: Maintain database schema for products, customers, transactions, sales, expenses, and purchases.

steps.title: Implement Customer and Grocery Product Data Models
steps.description: Manage data classes for Product, Customer, SaleItem, Expense, Purchase, and UdhaarTransaction.

steps.title: Build Dashboard User Interface and Analytics Overview
steps.description: Construct dashboard UI displaying live daily sales, pending udhaar, and quick action shortcuts.

steps.title: Implement Grocery Inventory Management and Product Creation Form
steps.description: Provide catalog views and form inputs for item pricing, stock levels, and strict unit selections.

steps.title: Build Customer Khata Ledger and Transaction History Screens
steps.description: Display customer accounts, total udhaar vs jama balance, and detailed payment history.

steps.title: Develop POS Terminal and Multi-Unit Cart Billing System
steps.description: Construct sale transaction terminal supporting quantity calculations, discounts, and payment mode options.

steps.title: Implement Udhaar and Jama Payment Modal Dialogs
steps.description: Provide input dialogs for adding new credit entries and recording cash/UPI payments against customer balances.

steps.title: Implement Store Expense Tracking and Stock Inward Features
steps.description: Enable recording daily operating expenses and inventory restock purchases from wholesale suppliers.

steps.title: Configure Financial Reports and CSV Data Export Manager
steps.description: Calculate overall net profit margins and enable local CSV backup generation.

steps.title: Building Al Faris Kirana
steps.description: Compile source code, verify database schema, and finalize application build.
